goal: Audit codebase for template references, verify GitHub repository template metadata, and provide automated solution to remove 'generated from' on GitHub

steps.title: Audit entire codebase and git history for any template references
steps.note: Audited 100% of codebase, git trees, commits, tags, and commit messages. Zero occurrences of aistudio or google-gemini template files exist in the codebase.

steps.title: Query GitHub API to inspect template_repository metadata on dynamo-mac and dynamomac
steps.note: Confirmed via GitHub API: dynamo-mac has template_repository stamped by GitHub, whereas dynamomac has template_repository=none. Confirmed GitHub API does not allow clearing template_repository via PATCH.

steps.title: Present findings and offer automated repository recreation to permanently remove template link on GitHub
